title: EA Selection Criteria & Evaluation Framework
buildup_idea: framework for evaluating EAs: (1) know system type (trend/breakout/mean-reversion) (2) backtest quality (real tick, 5-10 years, PF>1.3, Recovery>3, Max DD<30%, profit curve smooth) (3) risk controls (SL, no hidden martingale, spread/news filters, max DD cut) (4) forward test close to backtest - NOT a specific mechanism
novelty_note: systematic EA evaluation checklist; mentions trend-following (safe, SL clear), breakout (high risk, needs Max DD Cut), mean-reversion (high win-rate, trend-vulnerable)

title: MT4 Backtesting Lot Size Issue - Export Property Script Fix
buildon_idea: troubleshooting guide: minimum lot size from quant data manager (0.1) may not match broker (e.g. GoMini 0.01); use Export Property script in MT4 to extract broker properties, match them back in data manager to allow lower lot testing
novelty_note: solution for MT4 backtesting constraint when using QuantDataManager history - requires script-based property export and re-import
